title: Furious Corruption
description: This mod adds a few new blocks aswell as mobs and dimensions!
body:
**The corruption is spreading… and your world is next.**

This mod adds a powerful **corruption system** that slowly takes over your entire Minecraft world.
It spreads, evolves, and turns everything into something far more dangerous…

What starts small can quickly become unstoppable.

---

**WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?**

* Adds a **spreading corruption infection** across ALL dimensions
* Transforms terrain, blocks, and environments over time
* Introduces **new dimensions, biomes, mobs, and mechanics**
* Forces you to **adapt, survive, and fight back**

This isn’t just decoration — this is a **world-changing system**

---

**ITEMS & GEAR**

Fight corruption with corruption itself, though that's not everything.

* 🗡️ Corrupted Sword
* ⛏️ Corrupted Pickaxe
* 🪓 Corrupted Axe
* 🥄 Corrupted Shovel
* 🛡️ Corrupted Shield
* 🏹 Corrupted Bow + Arrows
* 🧥 Full Corrupted Armor
* 🍇 Bloodfruit
* 🧪 Distorting Soul, Faded Fate
* 🔥 Infernal Igniter & Infernal Nucleus
* 🧱 Distorting Chunk & Distorter
* 🪣 Bucket of Bloodwater & Distortion
* …and more coming soon!

⚠️ Distorted Items are planned.

---

**🧱 BLOCKS & WORLD CHANGES**

The world won’t stay normal for long.

* 🧬 Corrupted Blocks & raw Corruption
* 🟣 Distorting Soul blocks
* ![A Distorted Fate.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3cac77db6a8c4b8c24654e376168396ef0af5697.png)
* 🪨 Furious Obsidian
* ⛏️ Devious Obsidian Chunk Ore (and Deepslate version)
* 💎 Distorted Ore
* 🌊 Bloodwater & Melted Fate fluids

Everything you know starts to **change, spread, and mutate**.

---

**DIMENSIONS**

Explore completely new and dangerous worlds:

* 🌌 Devious Reality
* 👑 Distorting Kingdom
* ⚠️ Detrimental Restrainer

Each dimension has:

* unique terrain
* new dangers
* different survival challenges

---

**BIOMES**

Corruption creates new environments:

* 🟣 Distorting Domain
* 🪨 Devious Lands

Expect strange terrain, weird visuals, and constant danger 👀

---

**👁️ ENTITIES**

You’re not alone anymore…

* 🧍 Corrupted Man
* 🌀 Distorting Lucidity
* ➕ 20+ more planned!

Some mobs are:

* passive,
* hostile,
* extremely dangerous.

---

**🧪 EFFECTS**

Corruption affects YOU too:

* ☣️ Corrupted — weakens you ALOT
* ![The Corruptor Effect.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc636332936f646405ad8c19afe4827aefa40768.png)
* 🌀 Distorted — basically Corrupted but 5x times worse, rare to even get that effect.

* ![The Distorted Effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ccf8cc66888801c53e436194cdb3b80ff377ea7.png)

* You’ll need to adapt or suffer the consequences.

---

**EXTRA FEATURES**

* ✨ Corrupted Enchantment (work in progress)
* 🧑‍🌾 New Villager Profession: **Corruptorist**
* 🔧 More mechanics and content planned!

---

**DIFFICULTY**

This mod is **NOT easy**.

* Corruption spreads faster over time
* Enemies get stronger
* Survival gets harder

Recommended for players who want a real challenge

---

**🧪 DEVELOPMENT STATUS**

🚧 This mod is in **Alpha**

That means:

* new features are coming
* things may change
* bugs might exist

But there’s already **a LOT to explore** 🔥

---

**🚀 READY?**

If you want:

* a world that changes over time
* new dimensions to explore
* powerful gear to unlock
* and a real survival challenge

then jump in and try it yourself.

Have fun… and try not to get consumed.
